title: Straws are fine, cases terrible
text: Straws are fine, cases terrible. The straws and cleaners a great, but the cases are terrible. Unfinished, they left everything dusty, and when I washed them out to get rid of the dust, the caps no longer fit. I would not recommend them.

product_metadata.title: Reusable Metal Stainless Steel Straws: Replacement Set. 4 Reusable Straws + 2 Cotton Cleaning Brushes for Hot and Cold Drinks, Portable for Travel & Personal Use, 8.5 inches, by Ecotribe
features: ECO-FRIENDLY STRAWS: This set of environmentally friendly reusable drinking straws is convenient, durable and long lasting. It includes 4 metal straws and 2 cleaning brushes. Carry these metallic straws with you wherever you go to eliminate your use of throwaway straws that end up in landfills. Our metal straw pack is a quick and easy way to reduce your carbon footprint with each drink, and take a stand against plastic pollution. A sleek and chic sustainability statement.

TRAVEL FRIENDLY STRAWS: These 8.5 inch reusable straws travel so well that you can always carry them with you on-the-go. The 9.25 inch cleaning brush fits snuggly inside the stainless steel reusable straws so you can conveniently have a clean reusable metal straw for drinks on hand at home, the office, or whenever you are out enjoying a beverage.

SAFER STRAWS: Unlike cheap plastic straws, our metal straws with case are nontoxic & BPA free, making them safer for regular use. Made from 100% 18/8 stainless steel, these .32 inch (8 mm) wide eco straws will not rust or scratch. They're dishwasher safe, making it easy to clean and sterilize them before each use. Or you can use our 100% cotton & stainless steel cleaning brush to keep them clean on-the-go.

VERSATILE STRAWS: Ecotribe's sturdy, wide and large travel straws are long and versatile enough for use with a variety of tall tumblers, glasses, mugs and mason jars. They fit most commercial and major brand to-go cup lids. Whether you are looking for a perfect metal smoothie straw, metal milkshake straw, metal tea straw or metal soda straw, this is the solution for you! These 4 reusable straws are also a great option for other beverages from iced coffee to selzer or mixed drinks.

QUALITY STRAWS: Each of our 4 decorative metal straws are stamped with the Ecotribe logo, so this metal straw set exudes style. . This quality extends to your sipping experience as these long, reusable straws deliver pure beverage flavors without any aftertaste and offer a chilling effect.
